ops.text: You come upon a large group of gaunt- looking ogres.  They have been digging a tunnel in an attempt to escape.  The tunnel is almost complete, but they are too weak from hunger and fighting slime worms to complete the job.  Do you help?
You find an old shack.  Only Adon knows why it is buried so deep in these monster-infested caves.  You look through  a window and see that it is empty.  Do you enter?

Inside, you see a small cot with the skeletal figure of the former occupant.  Judging by the state of the corpse, he has been dead for many years.  With the exception of several books that stand out from the rest, the shack contains nothing of interest.
You happen upon a herd of dinosaurs.  They viciously defend their meager home.

Fresh water is a rare find in the underworld.  When it is available, it's usually claimed and carefully guarded.
This dead-end cavern is occupied by some unfriendly shantiles.
Large boulders careen downwards from a ridge above.  Those not fast enough to avoid the rocks are crushed beneath a hail of missiles.
The hail of boulders forces you to take up a defensive position.  Gnath seize the opportunity to close ranks and attack.
They carried little of value.  This was a perfect position for setting up an ambush.  Be careful of similar attacks in the future.

"We ask you to leave one last final time, citizens.  This area is restricted to you.  Do not make us take you by force."  Judging by the atmosphere in the barracks, you get the feeling they may attack if you stay any longer.  Do you leave?
"I hear the city council is planning on taking on King Sevren for rule of the whole province.  I'm telling ya, there be some sparks flying soon!"
You take all his possessions as you strip him down to his breeches.  "You ruffians shall pay dearly for this!  The King will spare no expense at expunging you and your kind!" he cries.
"Well, I should guess so.  I shall explain the error of your ways to the city guard.  It is fortunate for you that I am a patient man.  Now be gone, for I must return to my duties."

As he flees, he shouts to no one in particular.  "Help, I am being waylaid.  Help....Help!"  Unfortunately for you, the streets are filled with troops searching for you and they stream towards you.  They do not even ask you to throw down your arms.
Town guards rush towards you.  The corporal in charge screams, "They are the ones who murdered the good Magistrate.  Kill them!"  Troops are upon you before you can make good your escape.
"King Sevren's daughter disappeared a few days ago.  Rumor has it she turned into a Dragon and flew out of the tall tower.  I'm thinking too many people have been drinking too much grog."

"My sister's new boyfriend is the sergeant of the south gate.  He says the King's men captured a monster and have it chained beneath the guards' quarters.  A big brute it is, all green and scaly.  He set his mages to work on picking its brains."

You enter the barracks of the town guard.

As you enter, you hear sharp words being exchanged from two high-ranking men.  It would seem the guardsmen are split into two factions.  One faction appears to be headed by a man by the name of Haikur, the other by a man named Thurfur.

Before you catch too much of the argument, the barracks falls silent as all heads turn to you.  Thurfur comes over and demands to know your business for being there.  Not satisfied with your answer, he orders you to leave.  Do you leave?
"Very well.  Now is a rather poor time to test my never plentiful supply of patience."  Thurfur draws steel and falls upon you.

"We ask you to leave one last final time, citizens.  This area is restricted to you.  Do not make us take you by force."  Judging by the atmosphere in the barracks, you get the feeling they may attack if you stay any longer.  Do you leave?
Madam Osswel's specialty shop appears to be open.  As you glance in through the window, you recognize Madam Osswel as the old hag you saved from the ruffians.
This is an old abandoned well.  It looks to be a long ways down.  The bucket and crank are almost rotted out.  This well has not been in use for quite some time.

Your attempt at climbing down the well has failed.  You lose your grip and fall to the bottom.  Now you need to be rescued as well.  The boy bursts out in tears all over again.  What have you gotten into?
